description: Draw a rectangle, ellipse or polygon frame, or a straight line, on a page (Rectangle Frame, Ellipse Frame, Polygon Frame and Line tools). Frames are graphic placeholders by default; content "unassigned" draws a plain shape and "text" a text frame. Returns the new item's id

content.description: Frame content: graphic placeholder (default), text frame, or unassigned (a plain shape)

from.description: Line: start point [x, y] in mm from the page's top-left

name.description: Name for the new item (Layers panel)

sides.description: Polygon: number of sides (default: the Polygon Settings value)

starInset.description: Polygon: star inset (%); 0 draws a regular polygon (default: the Polygon Settings value)

to.description: Line: end point [x, y] in mm from the page's top-left

x.description: Left edge in mm from the page's left (not for lines)

y.description: Top edge in mm from the page's top (not for lines)

name: draw_shape
title: Draw Shape
